text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, pantoprazole sodium is not on FDA's current shortage list. Current inventory across Corvale sites ranges from 13.6 to 22.1 days of supply.

Why (FDA record): FDA's history shows a shortage first posted on 2019-05-28 that has since been resolved. FDA inspection 995337 at a registered plant ended 2016-12-15 and was classified VAI, 894 days before the 2019-05-28 shortage posting. FDA inspection 1066512 at the same plant ended 2018-09-21 and was classified VAI, 249 days before the 2019-05-28 shortage posting. FDA inspection 1110509 at the plant ended 2019-11-18 and was classified VAI, 174 days after the 2019-05-28 shortage posting.

Our position: Supply is adequate today. No active shortage exists. We will maintain current purchasing while qualifying additional sources to strengthen resilience.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Avenacy, LLC; requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer to qualify BE Pharmaceuticals Inc. as a secondary source; requires buyer and quality approval.
3. Buyer to qualify Baxter Healthcare Company as a tertiary source; requires buyer and quality approval.
4. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list weekly; requires buyer approval.
5. Buyer to report any supply changes to P&T committee at next meeting; requires buyer and P&T chair approval.

Not recommended: No allocation, rationing, or therapeutic substitution at this time.
